visit_note.text:
Date of visit: 2026-05-03
Patient: 76-year-old woman, established patient.
Chief complaint: palpitations
History: two episodes of palpitations this morning.
09:10 ECG: sinus rhythm, rate 78, no acute changes.
10:40 Palpitations returned while waiting; patient light-headed.
10:45 Repeat ECG: narrow-complex tachycardia, rate 164.
Plan: vagal manoeuvres effective; cardiology referral.
Electronically signed by the treating clinician, 2026-05-03.

expected.expected_correction: Add modifier 76 to line 2 and send a corrected claim.
expected.rationale: The note records two ECGs at different times with different findings, so the second is a repeat and not a duplicate. The policy asks for modifier 76 on the repeat line, which is all that is missing.
